record.original_question: Describe the dynamics of generic trajectories in parallelogram tiling billiards, where the plane is tiled by parallelograms with side vectors a_vec = (a, 0) and b_vec = (b sin alpha, b cos alpha) and the dynamics depends on the parameters alpha in (0, pi) and m = a/b.

evidence.quote: Question 2.Describe the dynamics of (at least, generic) trajectories ofparallelogram tiling billiards, defined in a tiling of the plane by parallelograms with sides parallel to the vectors ⃗a:= (a,0)and ⃗b:= (bsinα, bcosα), wherea, b∈R + ∗ andα∈(0, π). The tiling billiard dynamics depends on two parameters,αandm= a b.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Tile the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$ by congruent parallelograms whose sides are parallel to the vectors $\vec{a}=(a,0)$ and $\vec{b}=(b\sin\alpha,\,b\cos\alpha)$, where $a,b>0$ and $\alpha\in(0,\pi)$. A tiling billiard trajectory is a piecewise-linear oriented curve in the plane which, upon meeting the interior of an edge between two adjacent tiles, refracts across that edge with refraction coefficient $-1$ (i.e., the trajectory is reflected through the edge so that the angle of incidence equals the angle of refraction on the opposite side of the edge, modeling propagation through a metamaterial of refractive index $-1$); trajectories that hit a vertex are undefined. Up to similarity the dynamics depends only on the two parameters $\alpha\in(0,\pi)$ and $m=a/b\in(0,\infty)$.

Describe, as a function of $(\alpha,m)$, the qualitative dynamical behavior of generic trajectories of this parallelogram tiling billiard. In particular, determine for almost every initial condition (with respect to Lebesgue measure on the phase space of unit tangent vectors) whether the trajectory is periodic, drift-periodic (invariant under a non-trivial translation of the tiling), bounded, escapes to infinity in a single asymptotic direction at linear speed, deviates from such a direction sublinearly, or is dense in an open subset of the plane; and classify these regimes in the parameter space $(\alpha,m)\in(0,\pi)\times(0,\infty)$.
artifact.status_search_result: No general classification of generic trajectory dynamics for parallelogram tiling billiards appears in the literature. Tiling billiards in triangles and cyclic quadrilaterals have been studied via interval exchange transformations with flips and admit an integral of motion (signed distance to circumcenters), and recent work (2024–2025) extends results to cyclic N-gons, but parallelograms are generally non-cyclic and a complete description of generic dynamics in the $(\alpha,m)$ parameter space has not been established. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Deviations for Generalized Tiling Billiards in Cyclic Polygons
status_evidence.snippet: behavior of generalized tiling billiards in cyclic N-gons with N≥5 is considerably different from that of triangular and quadrilateral tiling billiards studied before
status_evidence.claim: Recent work focuses on cyclic polygons; parallelograms (non-cyclic in general) remain outside the scope of these results.

status_evidence.title: Negative refraction and tiling billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Tiling billiards introduced; analysis primarily for triangle tilings.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational work treats triangle tilings; general parallelogram case not resolved.
